<style>
    /* Scope biến CSS vào ID cha */
    #sp_Ticket_HistoryControl_html {
        --quote-primary: #2E7D32;
        --quote-primary-dark: #167549ff;
        --quote-danger: #E53935;
        --quote-warning: #FBC02D;
        --quote-info: #0288D1;
        height: 100%;
        padding-bottom: 15px;
        box-sizing: border-box;
    }

    #sp_Ticket_HistoryControl_html .text-dark {
        color: inherit !important;
    }

    #sp_Ticket_HistoryControl_html .filter-buttons {
        display: flex;
        justify-content: flex-end;
        margin-bottom: 10px;
        padding-right: 5px;
    }

    #sp_Ticket_HistoryControl_html #ticketModalOverlay {
        display: none;
        position: fixed;
        top: 0;
        left: 0;
        width: 100%;
        height: 100%;
        background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
        z-index: 9999;
        justify-content: center;
        align-items: center;
    }

    #sp_Ticket_HistoryControl_html #ticketModalContent {
        max-width: 55%;
        max-height: 90vh;
        border-radius: 8px;
        box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        overflow: hidden;
    }

    #sp_Ticket_HistoryControl_html .modal-header {
        background: #26bb76;
        color: #fdfdfd;
        padding: 15px;
        display: flex;
        justify-content: space-between;
        align-items: center;
        font-weight: bold;
        font-size: 16px;
    }

    #sp_Ticket_HistoryControl_html .modal-body {
        padding: 20px;
        overflow-y: auto;
    }

    #sp_Ticket_HistoryControl_html .ticket-form-label {
        font-weight: 600;
        margin-bottom: 5px;
        display: block;
        font-size: 13px;
    }

    #sp_Ticket_HistoryControl_html .ticket-form-label.required::after {
        content: " *";
        color: #e74c3c;
        font-weight: bold;
    }

    #sp_Ticket_HistoryControl_html .upload-container {
        border: 1px dashed #ccc;
        padding: 10px;
        border-radius: 4px;
    }

    #sp_Ticket_HistoryControl_html .modal-footer {
        padding: 15px;
        border-top: 1px solid #eee;
        display: flex;
        justify-content: flex-end;
        gap: 10px;
    }

    /* ===== BADGE CHUNG ===== */
    #sp_Ticket_HistoryControl_html #GridTicket .badge-view {
        color: #fdfdfd;
        text-align: center;
        padding: 0.4rem 0.75rem;
        border-radius: 0.5rem;
        font-weight: 500;
        font-size: 0.875rem;
        width: fit-content;
        border: 1px solid transparent;
        white-space: nowrap;
        display: inline-flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 0.25rem;
    }

    #sp_Ticket_HistoryControl_html #GridTicket .badge-view i {
        font-size: 0.9em;
    }

    /* ===== PRIORITY BADGES ===== */
    #sp_Ticket_HistoryControl_html #GridTicket .badge-view.bg-priority-low {
        background-color: #2E7D32 !important;
        border-color: #1B5E20 !important;
        color: #fdfdfd !important;
    }

    [data-theme="dark"] #sp_Ticket_HistoryControl_html #GridTicket .badge-view.bg-priority-low,
    .dark #sp_Ticket_HistoryControl_html #GridTicket .badge-view.bg-priority-low,
    body.dark #sp_Ticket_HistoryControl_html #GridTicket .badge-view.bg-priority-low {
        background-color: #388E3C !important;
        border-color: #2E7D32 !important;
        color: #fdfdfd !important;
    }

    #sp_Ticket_HistoryControl_html #GridTicket .badge-view.bg-priority-medium {
        background-color: #F57F17 !important;
        border-color: #E65100 !important;
        color: #fdfdfd !important;
    }

    [data-theme="dark"] #sp_Ticket_HistoryControl_html #GridTicket .badge-view.bg-priority-medium,
    .dark #sp_Ticket_HistoryControl_html #GridTicket .badge-view.bg-priority-medium,
    body.dark #sp_Ticket_HistoryControl_html #GridTicket .badge-view.bg-priority-medium {
        background-color: #F9A825 !important;
        color: #1a1a1a !important;
        border-color: #F57F17 !important;
    }

    #sp_Ticket_HistoryControl_html #GridTicket .badge-view.bg-priority-high {
        background-color: #E65100 !important;
        border-color: #BF360C !important;
        color: #fdfdfd !important;
    }

    [data-theme="dark"] #sp_Ticket_HistoryControl_html #GridTicket .badge-view.bg-priority-high,
    .dark #sp_Ticket_HistoryControl_html #GridTicket .badge-view.bg-priority-high,
    body.dark #sp_Ticket_HistoryControl_html #GridTicket .badge-view.bg-priority-high {
        background-color: #F4511E !important;
        border-color: #E64A19 !important;
        color: #fdfdfd !important;
    }

    #sp_Ticket_HistoryControl_html #GridTicket .badge-view.bg-priority-urgent {
        background-color: #B71C1C !important;
        border-color: #7F0000 !important;
        color: #fdfdfd !important;
        animation: pulse-urgent 2s infinite;
    }

    [data-theme="dark"] #sp_Ticket_HistoryControl_html #GridTicket .badge-view.bg-priority-urgent,
    .dark #sp_Ticket_HistoryControl_html #GridTicket .badge-view.bg-priority-urgent,
    body.dark #sp_Ticket_HistoryControl_html #GridTicket .badge-view.bg-priority-urgent {
        background-color: #C62828 !important;
        border-color: #B71C1C !important;
        color: #fdfdfd !important;
    }

    @keyframes pulse-urgent {
        0%, 100% { opacity: 1; }
        50% { opacity: 0.85; }
    }

    /* Chờ xác nhận - Xám #9E9E9E */
    #sp_Ticket_HistoryControl_html #GridTicket .badge-view.bg-draft,
    #sp_Ticket_HistoryControl_html #GridTicket .badge-view.bg-pending {
        background-color: #9E9E9E !important;
        border-color: #757575 !important;
        color: #fdfdfd !important;
    }

    [data-theme="dark"] #sp_Ticket_HistoryControl_html #GridTicket .badge-view.bg-draft,
    [data-theme="dark"] #sp_Ticket_HistoryControl_html #GridTicket .badge-view.bg-pending,
    .dark #sp_Ticket_HistoryControl_html #GridTicket .badge-view.bg-draft,
    .dark #sp_Ticket_HistoryControl_html #GridTicket .badge-view.bg-pending,
    body.dark #sp_Ticket_HistoryControl_html #GridTicket .badge-view.bg-draft,
    body.dark #sp_Ticket_HistoryControl_html #GridTicket .badge-view.bg-pending {
        background-color: #BDBDBD !important;
        color: #1a1a1a !important;
        border-color: #9E9E9E !important;
    }

    /* Đang xử lý - Xanh dương #2196F3 */
    #sp_Ticket_HistoryControl_html #GridTicket .badge-view.bg-processing {
        background-color: #2196F3 !important;
        border-color: #1565C0 !important;
        color: #fdfdfd !important;
    }

    [data-theme="dark"] #sp_Ticket_HistoryControl_html #GridTicket .badge-view.bg-processing,
    .dark #sp_Ticket_HistoryControl_html #GridTicket .badge-view.bg-processing,
    body.dark #sp_Ticket_HistoryControl_html #GridTicket .badge-view.bg-processing {
        background-color: #42A5F5 !important;
        color: #1a1a1a !important;
        border-color: #2196F3 !important;
    }

    /* Hoàn thành - Xanh lá #4CAF50 */
    #sp_Ticket_HistoryControl_html #GridTicket .badge-view.bg-completed {
        background-color: #4CAF50 !important;
        border-color: #2E7D32 !important;
        color: #fdfdfd !important;
    }

    [data-theme="dark"] #sp_Ticket_HistoryControl_html #GridTicket .badge-view.bg-completed,
    .dark #sp_Ticket_HistoryControl_html #GridTicket .badge-view.bg-completed,
    body.dark #sp_Ticket_HistoryControl_html #GridTicket .badge-view.bg-completed {
        background-color: #66BB6A !important;
        color: #1a1a1a !important;
        border-color: #4CAF50 !important;
    }

    /* Đã đóng - Tím #9C27B0 */
    #sp_Ticket_HistoryControl_html #GridTicket .badge-view.bg-closed {
        background-color: #9C27B0 !important;
        border-color: #6A1B9A !important;
        color: #fdfdfd !important;
    }

    [data-theme="dark"] #sp_Ticket_HistoryControl_html #GridTicket .badge-view.bg-closed,
    .dark #sp_Ticket_HistoryControl_html #GridTicket .badge-view.bg-closed,
    body.dark #sp_Ticket_HistoryControl_html #GridTicket .badge-view.bg-closed {
        background-color: #AB47BC !important;
        color: #fdfdfd !important;
        border-color: #9C27B0 !important;
    }

    /* Chưa hoàn thành / Hủy - Vàng #FF9800 */
    #sp_Ticket_HistoryControl_html #GridTicket .badge-view.bg-cancelled {
        background-color: #FF9800 !important;
        border-color: #E65100 !important;
        color: #1a1a1a !important;
    }

    [data-theme="dark"] #sp_Ticket_HistoryControl_html #GridTicket .badge-view.bg-cancelled,
    .dark #sp_Ticket_HistoryControl_html #GridTicket .badge-view.bg-cancelled,
    body.dark #sp_Ticket_HistoryControl_html #GridTicket .badge-view.bg-cancelled {
        background-color: #FFA726 !important;
        color: #1a1a1a !important;
        border-color: #FF9800 !important;
    }

    /* ===== CUSTOM BUTTON ===== */
    #sp_Ticket_HistoryControl_html .btn-custom-green.dx-button {
        background-color: #00673b !important;
        border-color: #00673b !important;
    }

    #sp_Ticket_HistoryControl_html .btn-custom-green.dx-button:hover {
        background-color: #004c2b !important;
        border-color: #004c2b !important;
    }

    #sp_Ticket_HistoryControl_html .btn-custom-green.dx-button:active,
    #sp_Ticket_HistoryControl_html .btn-custom-green.dx-button.dx-state-active {
        background-color: #003820 !important;
        border-color: #003820 !important;
    }

    #sp_Ticket_HistoryControl_html .btn-custom-green.dx-button .dx-button-text {
        color: white !important;
    }

    #sp_Ticket_HistoryControl_html .btn-custom-green.dx-button:hover .dx-button-text,
    #sp_Ticket_HistoryControl_html .btn-custom-green.dx-button:active .dx-button-text,
    #sp_Ticket_HistoryControl_html .btn-custom-green.dx-button.dx-state-active .dx-button-text {
        color: #fdfdfd !important;
    }

    /* ===== FILTER ===== */
    #sp_Ticket_HistoryControl_html .tk-filter-wrapper {
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: row;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 6px;
        margin-left: 0;
        white-space: nowrap;
        flex: 1 1 calc(22% - 12px);
        min-width: 220px;
        max-width: calc(50% - 6px);
    }

    #sp_Ticket_HistoryControl_html .tk-filter-label {
        font-size: 13px;
        font-weight: 600;
        color: #9ca3af;
        white-space: nowrap;
        min-width: 70px;
    }

    #sp_Ticket_HistoryControl_html .tk-filter-box {
        flex: 1 1 auto !important;
        width: 100% !important;
        height: 32px !important;
    }

    #sp_Ticket_HistoryControl_html .tk-filter-box.dx-selectbox {
        width: 100% !important;
    }

    /* ===== TOOLBAR / HEADER PANEL ===== */
    #sp_Ticket_HistoryControl_html .dx-datagrid-header-panel {
        height: auto !important;
        overflow: visible !important;
    }

    #sp_Ticket_HistoryControl_html .dx-datagrid-header-panel .dx-toolbar,
    #sp_Ticket_HistoryControl_html .dx-toolbar-items-container {
        height: auto !important;
        min-height: 40px;
        display: flex !important;
        flex-wrap: wrap !important;
        justify-content: space-between;
        overflow: visible !important;
    }

    #sp_Ticket_HistoryControl_html .dx-toolbar-before {
        display: flex !important;
        flex-direction: row !important;
        flex-wrap: wrap !important;
        align-items: center;
        position: static !important;
        max-width: 100% !important;
  flex: 1 1 auto;
        gap: 6px;
    }

    #sp_Ticket_HistoryControl_html .dx-toolbar-after {
        padding: 5px 0;
        display: flex !important;
        flex-wrap: wrap !important;
        align-items: center;
        position: static !important;
        margin-left: auto;
        gap: 4px;
    }

    #sp_Ticket_HistoryControl_html .dx-toolbar-after .dx-item,
    #sp_Ticket_HistoryControl_html .dx-toolbar-after .dx-toolbar-item {
        display: flex !important;
        align-items: center !important;
    }

    #sp_Ticket_HistoryControl_html .dx-toolbar-menu-container {
        display: none !important;
    }

    /* ===== MOBILE EYE-EXPAND ===== */
    #sp_Ticket_HistoryControl_html .tk-eye-btn {
        background: none;
        border: 1px solid #10b981;
        border-radius: 6px;
        color: #10b981;
        cursor: pointer;
        padding: 4px 8px;
        font-size: 16px;
        transition: all 0.2s;
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
    }

    #sp_Ticket_HistoryControl_html .tk-eye-btn:hover {
        background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.15);
    }

    #sp_Ticket_HistoryControl_html .tk-eye-btn.active {
        background: #10b981;
        color: #e8e8e8;
    }

    #sp_Ticket_HistoryControl_html .tk-expand-wrapper {
        display: none;
        overflow: hidden;
        width: 100%;
    }

    #sp_Ticket_HistoryControl_html .tk-mobile-expand-row {
        background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.05);
        border-top: 1px solid rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.15);
        padding: 10px 14px;
        display: grid !important;
        grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr) !important;
        gap: 10px 12px;
        width: 100%;
        box-sizing: border-box;
    }

    #sp_Ticket_HistoryControl_html .tk-expand-item {
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        gap: 3px;
    }

    #sp_Ticket_HistoryControl_html .tk-expand-label {
        font-size: 11px;
        color: #9ca3af;
        font-weight: 600;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        letter-spacing: 0.3px;
    }

    #sp_Ticket_HistoryControl_html .tk-expand-value {
        font-size: 13px;
        color: #d1d5db;
        font-weight: 500;
    }

    #sp_Ticket_HistoryControl_html .tk-expand-badge {
        display: inline-flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 4px;
        padding: 3px 10px;
        border-radius: 12px;
        font-size: 12px;
        font-weight: 600;
        width: fit-content;
    }

    /* ===== FILTER PANEL TĨNH ===== */
    #sp_Ticket_HistoryControl_html #tk-filter-panel-container {
        padding: 8px 12px;
        border-bottom: 1px solid var(--bs-border-color);
        background-color: var(--bs-body-bg);
    }

    #sp_Ticket_HistoryControl_html #tk-filter-panel {
        display: flex !important;
        flex-direction: row !important;
        flex-wrap: wrap !important;
        align-items: center !important;
        gap: 8px 12px !important;
    }

    #sp_Ticket_HistoryControl_html .tk-filter-clear-wrapper {
        margin-left: auto;
    }

    #sp_Ticket_HistoryControl_html #btn-clear-filter {
        color: #ef4444;
        border: 1px solid #ef4444;
        border-radius: 6px;
        padding: 4px 12px;
        font-size: 12px;
        background: transparent;
        cursor: pointer;
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        transition: all 0.2s;
    }

    #sp_Ticket_HistoryControl_html #btn-clear-filter:hover {
        background: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.1);
    }

    /* ===== MOBILE ===== */
    @media (max-width: 768px) {
        #sp_Ticket_HistoryControl_html #tk-filter-panel-container {
            display: none;
            padding: 10px;
            box-sizing: border-box;
        }

        #sp_Ticket_HistoryControl_html #tk-filter-panel-container.active {
            display: block !important;
        }

        #sp_Ticket_HistoryControl_html #tk-filter-panel {
            flex-direction: column !important;
            align-items: stretch !important;
            gap: 10px !important;
        }

        #sp_Ticket_HistoryControl_html .tk-filter-clear-wrapper {
            margin-left: 0 !important;
            display: flex !important;
            justify-content: flex-end !important;
        }

        #sp_Ticket_HistoryControl_html .dx-toolbar-items-container {
            height: auto !important;
        }

        #sp_Ticket_HistoryControl_html .dx-toolbar-after {
            display: flex !important;
            flex-wrap: wrap !important;
            justify-content: flex-end !important;
            align-items: center !important;
            position: static !important;
            padding: 5px 0 !important;
            gap: 6px !important;
        }

        #sp_Ticket_HistoryControl_html .dx-toolbar-before {
            display: none !important;
        }

        #sp_Ticket_HistoryControl_html .dx-toolbar-after .dx-button,
        #sp_Ticket_HistoryControl_html .tk-filter-toggle-btn {
            height: 34px !important;
            min-width: 34px !important;
            border-radius: 6px !important;
            display: flex !important;
            align-items: center !important;
            justify-content: center !important;
            margin: 0 !important;
            flex-shrink: 0 !important;
        }

        #sp_Ticket_HistoryControl_html .dx-toolbar-after .dx-button .dx-button-content {
            padding: 0 !important;
            display: flex !important;
            align-items: center !important;
            justify-content: center !important;
            height: 100% !important;
        }

        #sp_Ticket_HistoryControl_html .dx-toolbar-after .dx-item:not(:first-child) .dx-button,
        #sp_Ticket_HistoryControl_html .tk-filter-toggle-btn {
            width: 36px !important;
            padding: 0 !important;
        }

        #sp_Ticket_HistoryControl_html .dx-toolbar-after .btn-custom-green {
            width: auto !important;
            padding: 0 12px !important;
        }

        #sp_Ticket_HistoryControl_html .btn-hdsd .dx-button-text {
            display: none !important;
        }

        #sp_Ticket_HistoryControl_html .btn-hdsd .dx-icon {
            margin: 0 !important;
        }

        #sp_Ticket_HistoryControl_html .dx-toolbar-after .dx-item {
            flex-shrink: 0 !important;
        }

        #sp_Ticket_HistoryControl_html #ticketModalContent {
            max-width: 95% !important;
            width: 95% !important;
        }

        #sp_Ticket_HistoryControl_html .tk-filter-wrapper {
            margin-left: 0 !important;
            margin-bottom: 6px !important;
            width: 100% !important;
            max-width: 100% !important;
            box-sizing: border-box !important;
            display: flex !important;
            padding-right: 4px !important;
        }

        #sp_Ticket_HistoryControl_html .tk-filter-box,
        #sp_Ticket_HistoryControl_html .tk-filter-box.dx-selectbox {
            flex: 1 1 0% !important;
            width: 0 !important;
            min-width: 0 !important;
        }

        #sp_Ticket_HistoryControl_html .tk-filter-label {
            min-width: 70px !important;
            max-width: 70px !important;
            flex-shrink: 0;
            font-size: 12px !important;
        }

        #sp_Ticket_HistoryControl_html .tk-filter-clear-row {
            display: flex !important;
            justify-content: flex-end !important;
            width: 100% !important;
            margin-top: 4px !important;
            padding-right: 0 !important;
        }

        #sp_Ticket_HistoryControl_html .dx-datagrid-scroll-container {
            overflow-x: hidden !important;
        }


        #sp_Ticket_HistoryControl_html .dx-datagrid-search-panel {
            width: 100% !important;
            margin: 5px 0 !important;
        }
    }
</style>

<div id="sp_Ticket_HistoryControl_html">
    <!-- Filter panel cố định phía trên Grid cho cả Desktop và Mobile -->
    <div id="tk-filter-panel-container" class="bg-body">
        <div id="tk-filter-panel">
            <div class="tk-filter-wrapper">
                <span class="tk-filter-label">Công ty:</span>
                <div class="tk-filter-box" id="FilterCompany"></div>
            </div>
            <div class="tk-filter-wrapper">
                <span class="tk-filter-label">Nhân viên:</span>
                <div class="tk-filter-box" id="FilterEmployee"></div>
            </div>
            <div class="tk-filter-wrapper">
                <span class="tk-filter-label">Từ ngày:</span>
                <div class="tk-filter-box" id="FilterFromDate"></div>
            </div>
            <div class="tk-filter-wrapper">
                <span class="tk-filter-label">Đến ngày:</span>
                <div class="tk-filter-box" id="FilterToDate"></div>
            </div>
            <div class="tk-filter-clear-wrapper">
                <button type="button" id="btn-clear-filter" class="btn btn-sm">
                    <i class="bi bi-x-circle me-1"></i> Xóa lọc
                </button>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <div id="GridTicket" style="height: 100%;"></div>

    <div id="ticketModalOverlay">
        <div id="ticketModalContent" class="bg-body">
            <div class="modal-header">
                <span><i class="fa fa-ticket-alt me-2"></i> Tạo yêu cầu hỗ trợ mới</span>
                <button type="button" style="background:none;border:none;color:#fdfdfd;font-size:20px;cursor:pointer;"
                    onclick="window.closeTicketModal()">×</button>
            </div>

            <div class="modal-body">
                <div class="row g-3">
                    <div class="col-md-6 ">
                        <label class="ticket-form-label required">Tên khách hàng</label>
                        <div id="P204298E1C9314A0582404443CBB5D8A7"></div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="col-md-6 ">
                        <label class="ticket-form-label required">Email</label>
                        <div id="PCA74EB22EAFB4496B36C0207AE3E070B"></div>
                    </div>

                    <div class="col-md-6 ">
                        <label class="ticket-form-label">Bộ phận hỗ trợ</label>
                        <div id="P252C9FAACFA748C6BE6238266555C999"></div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="col-md-6 ">
                        <label class="ticket-form-label required">Nhân viên hỗ trợ</label>
                        <div id="PBCCAC0E331424C56ACC6E04F90D5B9D5"></div>
                    </div>

                    <div class="col-md-6 ">
                        <label class="ticket-form-label">Loại hỗ trợ</label>
      <div id="PE1E3F98AED2F407EB0710D05E3C391BE"></div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="col-md-6 ">
                        <label class="ticket-form-label">Mức độ ưu tiên</label>
                        <div id="PD96D81AC1BF3478BB8F74E08C4751659"></div>
                    </div>

                    <div class="col-12 ">
                        <label class="ticket-form-label required">Tiêu đề</label>
                        <div id="P445AB4D6127F481D840E462DF5CC093A"></div>
                    </div>

    function _ticketZipWorkbook(files) {
        const encoder = new TextEncoder();
        const crcTable = [];
        for (let n = 0; n < 256; n++) {
            let c = n;
            for (let k = 0; k < 8; k++) c = (c & 1) ? (0xEDB88320 ^ (c >>> 1)) : (c >>> 1);

        }
        function header(size) {
            const bytes = new Uint8Array(size);
            return { bytes: bytes, view: new DataView(bytes.buffer) };
        }

        const now = new Date();
        const dosTime = ((now.getHours() & 31) << 11) | ((now.getMinutes() & 63) << 5) | ((Math.floor(now.getSeconds() / 2)) & 31);
        const dosDate = (((now.getFullYear() - 1980) & 127) << 9) | (((now.getMonth() + 1) & 15) << 5) | (now.getDate() & 31);
        const localParts = [];
        const centralParts = [];
        let localOffset = 0;

        files.forEach(function(file) {
            const nameBytes = encoder.encode(file.name);
            const dataBytes = typeof file.data === "string" ? encoder.encode(file.data) : file.data;
            const crc = crc32(dataBytes);
            const local = header(30);
            local.view.setUint32(0, 0x04034B50, true);
            local.view.setUint16(4, 20, true);
            local.view.setUint16(6, 0x0800, true);
            local.view.setUint16(8, 0, true);
            local.view.setUint16(10, dosTime, true);
            local.view.setUint16(12, dosDate, true);
            local.view.setUint32(14, crc, true);
            local.view.setUint32(18, dataBytes.length, true);
            local.view.setUint32(22, dataBytes.length, true);
            local.view.setUint16(26, nameBytes.length, true);
            local.view.setUint16(28, 0, true);
            localParts.push(local.bytes, nameBytes, dataBytes);

            const central = header(46);
            central.view.setUint32(0, 0x02014B50, true);
            central.view.setUint16(4, 20, true);
            central.view.setUint16(6, 20, true);
            central.view.setUint16(8, 0x0800, true);
            central.view.setUint16(10, 0, true);
            central.view.setUint16(12, dosTime, true);
            central.view.setUint16(14, dosDate, true);
            central.view.setUint32(16, crc, true);
            central.view.setUint32(20, dataBytes.length, true);
            central.view.setUint32(24, dataBytes.length, true);
            central.view.setUint16(28, nameBytes.length, true);
            central.view.setUint16(30, 0, true);
            central.view.setUint16(32, 0, true);
            central.view.setUint16(34, 0, true);
            central.view.setUint16(36, 0, true);
            central.view.setUint32(38, 0, true);
            central.view.setUint32(42, localOffset, true);
            centralParts.push(central.bytes, nameBytes);
            localOffset += local.bytes.length + nameBytes.length + dataBytes.length;
        });

        const centralBytes = _ticketConcatBytes(centralParts);
        const end = header(22);
        end.view.setUint32(0, 0x06054B50, true);
        end.view.setUint16(4, 0, true);
        end.view.setUint16(6, 0, true);
        end.view.setUint16(8, files.length, true);
        end.view.setUint16(10, files.length, true);
        end.view.setUint32(12, centralBytes.length, true);
        end.view.setUint32(16, localOffset, true);
        end.view.setUint16(20, 0, true);
        return _ticketConcatBytes(localParts.concat([centralBytes, end.bytes]));
    }

    async function getTicketMessagesText(ticketID) {
        const vi = String(LanguageID || "VN").toUpperCase() === "VN";

        function decodeHtmlEntities(str) {
            if (!str) return "";
            return str
                .replace(/ /gi, " ")
                .replace(/</gi, "<")
                .replace(/>/gi, ">")
                .replace(/&/gi, "&")
                .replace(/"/gi, '"')
                .replace(/'/gi, "'");
        }

        function cleanHtmlToPlainText(html) {
            if (!html) return "";
            // Replace line breaks / block elements with actual newlines
            let text = html
                .replace(/<br\s*\/?>/gi, "\n")
                .replace(/<\/p>/gi, "\n")
                .replace(/<\/div>/gi, "\n")
                .replace(/<\/tr>/gi, "\n")
                .replace(/<\/li>/gi, "\n");
            // Strip remaining tags
            text = text.replace(/<[^>]*>/g, "");
            // Decode HTML entities
            text = decodeHtmlEntities(text);

            // Clean up consecutive empty lines
            let lines = text.split("\n").map(line => line.trim());
            let cleanedLines = [];
            let lastWasEmpty = false;
            lines.forEach(line => {
                if (line === "") {
                    if (!lastWasEmpty) {
                        cleanedLines.push("");
                        lastWasEmpty = true;
                    }
                } else {
                    cleanedLines.push(line);
                    lastWasEmpty = false;
                }
            });
            return cleanedLines.join("\n").trim();
        }

        return new Promise((resolve) => {
            AjaxHPAParadise({
                data: {
                    name: "sp_Ticket_LoadMessageTicket",
                    param: ["LoginID", LoginID, "TicketID", ticketID]
                },
                success: function (res) {
                    try {
                        const json = typeof res === "string" ? JSON.parse(res) : res;
                        const list = json.data && json.data[0];
                        if (list && list.length > 0) {
                            let sortedList = [...list].sort((a, b) => new Date(a.CreatedDate) - new Date(b.CreatedDate));
                            let messageLines = [];
                            sortedList.forEach(item => {
                                if (item.Message) {
                                    let plainText = cleanHtmlToPlainText(item.Message);
                                    if (plainText) {
                                        let senderLabel = "";
                                        if (item.SenderID === 1) {
                                            senderLabel = (vi ? "Khách hàng" : "Customer") + (item.NameUser ? ` - ${item.NameUser}` : "");
                                        } else if (item.SenderID === 2) {
                                            senderLabel = (vi ? "Nhân viên" : "Staff") + (item.NameEmployee ? ` - ${item.NameEmployee}` : "");
                                        } else {
                                            senderLabel = item.SenderName || (vi ? "Không rõ" : "Unknown");
                                        }
                                        let dateStr = "";
                                        if (item.CreatedDate) {
                                            let d = new Date(item.CreatedDate);
                                            dateStr = ` (${d.getDate()}/${d.getMonth()+1}/${d.getFullYear()} ${("0"+d.getHours()).slice(-2)}:${("0"+d.getMinutes()).slice(-2)})`;
                                        }
                                        messageLines.push(`[${senderLabel}${dateStr}]:\n${plainText}`);
                                    }
                                }
                            });
                            resolve(messageLines.join("\n\n"));
                        } else {
                            resolve("");
                        }
                    } catch (e) {
                        resolve("");
                    }
                },
                error: function () {
                    resolve("");
                }
            });
        });
    }

                let row = rows[currentIndex];
                if (row && row.TicketID) {
                    row.FeedbackHistory = await getTicketMessagesText(row.TicketID);
                }
            }
        }
        let workers = [];
        for (let i = 0; i < Math.min(concurrency, rows.length); i++) {
            workers.push(worker());
        }
        await Promise.all(workers);
    }

    function exportTicketReportExcel() {
        const container = "#sp_Ticket_HistoryControl_html";
        const vi = String(LanguageID || "VN").toUpperCase() === "VN";
        showLoadingByClassOrID(container, vi ? "Đang tải dữ liệu..." : "Loading data...");
        AjaxHPAParadise({
            data: { name: "sp_LoadGridUsingAPI", param: _ticketBuildExportParams() },
            success: async function(response) {
                try {
                    const json = typeof response === "string" ? JSON.parse(response) : response;
                    const rows = Array.isArray(json?.data?.[0]) ? json.data[0] : [];

                    showLoadingByClassOrID(container, vi ? "Đang tải lịch sử phản hồi..." : "Loading feedback history...");
                    await loadAllTicketMessages(rows);
                    showLoadingByClassOrID(container, vi ? "Đang tạo file Excel..." : "Generating Excel file...");

                    const bytes = _ticketCreateXlsx(rows);
                    const blob = new Blob([bytes], { type: "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet" });
                    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
                    const link = document.createElement("a");
                    const stamp = new Date();
                    const fileStamp = stamp.getFullYear() + ("0" + (stamp.getMonth() + 1)).slice(-2) + ("0" + stamp.getDate()).slice(-2) + "_" + ("0" + stamp.getHours()).slice(-2) + ("0" + stamp.getMinutes()).slice(-2);
                    link.href = url;
                    link.download = `Ticket_Report_${fileStamp}.xlsx`;
                    document.body.appendChild(link);
                    link.click();
                    link.remove();
                    setTimeout(function() { URL.revokeObjectURL(url); }, 1000);
                    uiManager.showAlert({ type: "success", message: vi ? `Đã xuất ${rows.length} ticket` : `Exported ${rows.length} tickets` });
                } catch (error) {
                    console.error("Ticket Excel export failed", error);
                    uiManager.showAlert({ type: "error", message: vi ? "Không thể tạo file Excel" : "Cannot create Excel file" });
                } finally {
                    HideLoadingByClassOrID(container);
                }
            },
            error: function(xhr, status, error) {
                HideLoadingByClassOrID(container);
                console.error("Ticket export data load failed", error);
                uiManager.showAlert({ type: "error", message: vi ? "Không thể tải dữ liệu xuất báo cáo" : "Cannot load report data" });
            }
        });
    }

 fontSize: "18px",
 color: i <= currentRating ? "#FFD700" : "#D1D5DB",

                                                transition: "color 0.2s, transform 0.1s"
                            })

            // Hover effect

                                                     // ✅ CẬP NHẬT DATA TRONG GRID

                                                        // ✅ CẬP NHẬT HIỂN THỊ

                                                            type: "error",
                                                            message: "Không thể lưu đánh giá!"

                                            updateStars(options.data.Rating || 0);

                                                });
                                            });
                                        } else {
                                            // Không cho phép tương tác
                                            $star.on("click", function(e) {
                                            e.stopPropagation();

        if (!isTicketCreator) {

                                                        type: "warning",

                                                } else if (!isTicketClosed) {
                                              uiManager.showAlert({
                                                    type: "warning",
                                                    message: "Chỉ có thể đánh giá khi đơn đã đóng!"
                                    });
                                                }
                });
                                        }

                    // ===== CỘT CON MẮT - CHỈ HIỆN TRÊN MOBILE =====
                    if (!columns.find(c => c.name === "EyeColumn")) {
                        columns.push({
                          name: "EyeColumn",

                                        $(this).closest(".tk-mobile-expand-row-tr").remove();

                                    $("#sp_Ticket_HistoryControl_html .tk-eye-btn").removeClass("active").find("i").removeClass("bi-eye-slash").addClass("bi-eye");

                                    // 3. Đổi icon ngay
                                    $btn.addClass("active").find("i").removeClass("bi-eye").addClass("bi-eye-slash");

                                    // Format ngày

                                    const $expandContent = $("<div>").addClass("tk-mobile-expand-row").appendTo($expandWrapper);

                                            stIcon = 'bi-x-circle-fill';
                                        }

                                        statusBadge = '<span class="tk-expand-badge" style="background:' + stBg + '; color:' + stColor + '; padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px;"><i class="bi ' + stIcon + '"></i>' + sName + '</span>';

                                    // === Tạo badge ưu tiên ===
                                    let priorityBadge = '--';
                                        if (rowData.LevelName) {
                                            let prBg = '#6c757d';
                                            let prColor = '#fdfdfd';
                                            let prIcon = 'bi-question-circle';
                                            const lv = rowData.LevelName;
                                            const levelVal = lv.toLowerCase();

                                                prBg = '#F57F17';
                                                prColor = '#fff';

           '<div class="tk-expand-item">' +
                                            '<span class="tk-expand-label"><i class="bi bi-layers-fill me-1"></i>Mức độ ưu tiên</span>' +
                                            priorityBadge +
                                        '</div>'
                                    );

                                    // === Thêm mục Rating ===

                                    const r_ticketCreatorID = rowData.CRM_CustomerID;
                                    const r_currentUserCRM_ID = rowData.CurrentUserCRM_CustomerID;
                                    const r_isTicketCreator = r_ticketCreatorID && r_currentUserCRM_ID && r_ticketCreatorID.toString() === r_currentUserCRM_ID.toString();
                                    const r_isTicketClosed = r_statusID === 3;
                                    const r_canRate = r_isTicketCreator && r_isTicketClosed;

                                    const $ratingVal = $("<div>").addClass("tk-expand-value").css({ display: "flex", gap: "2px" }).appendTo($ratingItem);

                                    function renderMobileStars(rating) {
                                        $ratingVal.empty();
                                        for (let i = 1; i <= 5; i++) {
                                            const $star = $("<i>").addClass("bi")
                                                .addClass(i <= rating ? "bi-star-fill" : "bi-star")
                                                .css({ fontSize: "16px", color: i <= rating ? "#FFD700" : "#D1D5DB", transition: "color 0.2s" })
                                                .attr("data-rating", i)
                                                .appendTo($ratingVal);

                                            if (r_canRate) {
                                                $star.on("click", function(ev) {
                                                    ev.stopPropagation();
                                                    const newRating = $(this).data("rating");
                                                    AjaxHPAParadise({
                                                        data: { name: "sp_Ticket_SaveRating", param: ["TicketID", r_ticketID, "Rating", newRating, "LoginID", LoginID] },

                                                            rowData.Rating = newRating;
                                                            renderMobileStars(newRating);
                                                            uiManager.showAlert({ type: "success", message: `Đã đánh giá ${newRating} sao!` });

                                                        error: function(err) {
                                                            uiManager.showAlert({ type: "error", message: "Không thể lưu đánh giá!" });
                                                            renderMobileStars(rowData.Rating || 0);
                                                        }
                                                    });
                                                });
                                            } else {
                                                $star.on("click", function(ev) {
                                                    ev.stopPropagation();
                                                    if (!r_isTicketCreator) uiManager.showAlert({ type: "warning", message: "Chỉ người tạo yêu cầu mới được đánh giá!" });

                                    renderMobileStars(ratingCurrent);
                     const hasFullAccess = rowData.HasFullAccessRight === true;

                                    }).appendTo(container);

                                    $("<div/>").dxButton({

                                        icon: "trash",

                                        stylingMode: "text",

                                        onClick: function (e) {
                                            e.event.stopPropagation();

                                // ✅ Không có quyền → hiện warning, KHÔNG disabled, giống rating
                                            if (!canDelete) {
                                                uiManager.showAlert({
                                                    type: "warning",
                  message: "Bạn không có quyền thực hiện thao tác này."
               });
                                                return;
                                            }

                                            window.deleteTicket(options.data.TicketID);
                                        }
}).appendTo($wrapper);
                                }
 });
                        }
                    });
                    gridInstance.option("scrolling", {
                        mode: "infinite",
                        rowRenderingMode: "virtual",
                        preloadEnabled: false
                    });

                    gridInstance.option("remoteOperations", {
                        paging: true,
                        filtering: true,
                        sorting: true,
                        searching: true
                    });

                    function getGridHeight() {
                        const gridEl = gridInstance.element();
                        const domElement = gridEl.jquery ? gridEl[0] : gridEl;
                        const top = domElement.getBoundingClientRect().top;
                        const newHeight = window.innerHeight - top - 20;
                        return newHeight > 300 ? newHeight : 500;

                    // Set paging config
                    gridInstance.option("paging.enabled", true);
                    gridInstance.option("paging.pageSize", 50);
                    gridInstance.option("pager.visible", false);
                    gridInstance.option("searchPanel.highlightSearchText", false);
                    gridInstance.option("height", getGridHeight());

                    $(window).on("resize", function() {
                        if (gridInstance && typeof gridInstance.option === "function") {
                            gridInstance.option("height", getGridHeight());

                    });

                    gridInstance.option("dataSource", dataStore_GridTicket);

                    gridInstance.endUpdate();

                    // Khởi tạo các DevExpress filter controls
                    window._initFilterControls();

                    // Đăng ký sự kiện cho nút xóa lọc tĩnh
                    $("#btn-clear-filter").on("click", function() {
                        if (window.FilterFromDateInstance) window.FilterFromDateInstance.option("value", null);
                        if (window.FilterToDateInstance) window.FilterToDateInstance.option("value", null);
                        if (window.FilterEmployeeInstance) window.FilterEmployeeInstance.option("value", null);
                        if (window.FilterCompanyInstance) window.FilterCompanyInstance.option("value", null);
                        window.currentFilters = {};
                        applyGridFilters();
                        uiManager.showAlert({ type: "info", message: "Đã xóa bộ lọc!" });

                    gridInstance.on("optionChanged", function(e) {
                         if (e.name === "searchPanel" && e.fullName === "searchPanel.text") {
                              gridInstance.refresh();
  }
                    });
                    
    }
    ReloadData()
        }) ();

    function _ticketConcatBytes(parts) {
        const total = parts.reduce((sum, part) => sum + part.length, 0);
        const output = new Uint8Array(total);
        let offset = 0;
        parts.forEach(function(part) {
            output.set(part, offset);
            offset += part.length;
        });
        return output;
    }

    function _ticketZipWorkbook(files) {
        const encoder = new TextEncoder();
        const crcTable = [];
        for (let n = 0; n < 256; n++) {
            let c = n;
            for (let k = 0; k < 8; k++) c = (c & 1) ? (0xEDB88320 ^ (c >>> 1)) : (c >>> 1);
            crcTable[n] = c >>> 0;
        }
        function crc32(bytes) {
            let crc = 0xFFFFFFFF;
            for (let i = 0; i < bytes.length; i++) crc = crcTable[(crc ^ bytes[i]) & 0xFF] ^ (crc >>> 8);
            return (crc ^ 0xFFFFFFFF) >>> 0;
        }
        function header(size) {
            const bytes = new Uint8Array(size);
            return { bytes: bytes, view: new DataView(bytes.buffer) };
        }

        const now = new Date();
        const dosTime = ((now.getHours() & 31) << 11) | ((now.getMinutes() & 63) << 5) | ((Math.floor(now.getSeconds() / 2)) & 31);
        const dosDate = (((now.getFullYear() - 1980) & 127) << 9) | (((now.getMonth() + 1) & 15) << 5) | (now.getDate() & 31);
        const localParts = [];
        const centralParts = [];
        let localOffset = 0;

        files.forEach(function(file) {
            const nameBytes = encoder.encode(file.name);
            const dataBytes = typeof file.data === "string" ? encoder.encode(file.data) : file.data;
            const crc = crc32(dataBytes);
            const local = header(30);
            local.view.setUint32(0, 0x04034B50, true);
            local.view.setUint16(4, 20, true);
            local.view.setUint16(6, 0x0800, true);
            local.view.setUint16(8, 0, true);
            local.view.setUint16(10, dosTime, true);
            local.view.setUint16(12, dosDate, true);
            local.view.setUint32(14, crc, true);
            local.view.setUint32(18, dataBytes.length, true);
            local.view.setUint32(22, dataBytes.length, true);
            local.view.setUint16(26, nameBytes.length, true);
            local.view.setUint16(28, 0, true);
            localParts.push(local.bytes, nameBytes, dataBytes);

            const central = header(46);
            central.view.setUint32(0, 0x02014B50, true);
            central.view.setUint16(4, 20, true);
            central.view.setUint16(6, 20, true);
            central.view.setUint16(8, 0x0800, true);
            central.view.setUint16(10, 0, true);
            central.view.setUint16(12, dosTime, true);
            central.view.setUint16(14, dosDate, true);
            central.view.setUint32(16, crc, true);
            central.view.setUint32(20, dataBytes.length, true);
            central.view.setUint32(24, dataBytes.length, true);
            central.view.setUint16(28, nameBytes.length, true);
            central.view.setUint16(30, 0, true);
            central.view.setUint16(32, 0, true);
            central.view.setUint16(34, 0, true);
            central.view.setUint16(36, 0, true);
            central.view.setUint32(38, 0, true);
            central.view.setUint32(42, localOffset, true);
            centralParts.push(central.bytes, nameBytes);
            localOffset += local.bytes.length + nameBytes.length + dataBytes.length;
        });

        const centralBytes = _ticketConcatBytes(centralParts);
        const end = header(22);
        end.view.setUint32(0, 0x06054B50, true);
        end.view.setUint16(4, 0, true);
        end.view.setUint16(6, 0, true);
        end.view.setUint16(8, files.length, true);
        end.view.setUint16(10, files.length, true);
        end.view.setUint32(12, centralBytes.length, true);
        end.view.setUint32(16, localOffset, true);
        end.view.setUint16(20, 0, true);
        return _ticketConcatBytes(localParts.concat([centralBytes, end.bytes]));
    }

              formatter: function(value, row) { return durationBetweenFields(row, "CreatedDate", "ReceivedDate"); } },

        ];

        function durationText(ms) {
            if (ms === null || ms === undefined || !isFinite(ms)) return "";
            const totalMinutes = Math.max(0, Math.round(ms / 60000));
            const days = Math.floor(totalMinutes / 1440);
            const hours = Math.floor((totalMinutes % 1440) / 60);
            const minutes = totalMinutes % 60;
            if (vi) {
                if (days > 0) return days + " ngày " + hours + " giờ " + minutes + " phút";
                if (hours > 0) return hours + " giờ " + minutes + " phút";
                return minutes + " phút";
            }
            if (days > 0) return days + "d " + hours + "h " + minutes + "m";
            if (hours > 0) return hours + "h " + minutes + "m";
            return minutes + "m";
        }

        function durationBetweenFields(row, startField, endField) {
            const start = row[startField] ? new Date(row[startField]) : null;
            const end = row[endField] ? new Date(row[endField]) : null;
            if (!start || !end || isNaN(start.getTime()) || isNaN(end.getTime())) return "";
            const diff = end.getTime() - start.getTime();
            return diff >= 0 ? durationText(diff) : "";
        }

        function averageDurationText(startField, endField) {
            let total = 0;
            let count = 0;
            rows.forEach(function(row) {
                const start = row[startField] ? new Date(row[startField]) : null;
                const end = row[endField] ? new Date(row[endField]) : null;
                if (!start || !end || isNaN(start.getTime()) || isNaN(end.getTime())) return;
                const diff = end.getTime() - start.getTime();
                if (diff < 0) return;
                total += diff;
                count++;
            });
            return count > 0 ? durationText(total / count) : "";
        }
        function cellXml(reference, value, style, type) {
            if (value === null || value === undefined || value === "") return `<c r="${reference}" s="${style || 0}"/>`;
            if (type === "number" && !isNaN(Number(value))) return `<c r="${reference}" s="${style || 0}" t="n"><v>${Number(value)}</v></c>`;

    function _ticketBuildExportParams() {
        const gridInstance = InstanceGridTicketPBE85F4D0401941B491282F2377C47C18;
        const params = ["@ProcName", "spTicket_apiGetInfomationTicketUser"];
        let procParam = `@LoginID=${LoginID},@Language='${LanguageID}'`;
        const filters = window.currentFilters || {};
        if (filters.companyID) procParam += `,@CompanyID=${filters.companyID}`;
        if (filters.employeeName) {
            const employeeName = String(filters.employeeName).replace(/'/g, "''");
            procParam += `,@EmployeeName=N'${employeeName}'`;
        }
        if (filters.fromDate) {
            const fromDate = new Date(filters.fromDate);
            const fromText = fromDate.getFullYear() + "-" + ("0" + (fromDate.getMonth() + 1)).slice(-2) + "-" + ("0" + fromDate.getDate()).slice(-2);
            procParam += `,@FromDate='${fromText}'`;
        }
        if (filters.toDate) {
            const toDate = new Date(filters.toDate);
            const toText = toDate.getFullYear() + "-" + ("0" + (toDate.getMonth() + 1)).slice(-2) + "-" + ("0" + toDate.getDate()).slice(-2);
            procParam += `,@ToDate='${toText}'`;
        }
        params.push("@ProcParam", procParam, "@Take", 1000000, "@Skip", 0, "@RequireTotalCount", 0);

        const keyword = (gridInstance.option("searchPanel.text") || "").trim();
        if (keyword) params.push("@SearchValue", keyword, "@ColumnSearch", "ShortDescription,FullNameUser,FullNameEmployee,TicketStatusName,LevelName,Company");

        const combinedFilter = gridInstance.getCombinedFilter ? gridInstance.getCombinedFilter(true) : null;
        if (combinedFilter) {
            const hasFunction = JSON.stringify(combinedFilter, function(key, value) { return typeof value === "function" ? "FUNCTION" : value; }).includes("FUNCTION");
            if (!hasFunction && typeof createConditionQuery === "function") params.push("@Filters", createConditionQuery(combinedFilter));
        }

        const sortedColumns = (gridInstance.getVisibleColumns ? gridInstance.getVisibleColumns() : [])
            .filter(function(col) { return col.dataField && col.sortOrder; })
            .sort(function(a, b) { return (a.sortIndex || 0) - (b.sortIndex || 0); });
        const sortText = sortedColumns.length
            ? sortedColumns.map(function(col) { return col.dataField + (col.sortOrder === "desc" ? " DESC" : " ASC"); }).join(",")
            : "CASE StatusID WHEN 0 THEN 1 WHEN 1 THEN 2 WHEN 5 THEN 3 WHEN 2 THEN 4 WHEN 3 THEN 5 WHEN 4 THEN 6 ELSE 7 END, CreatedDate DESC";
        params.push("@Sort", "ORDER BY " + sortText);
        return params;
    }

    async function getTicketMessagesText(ticketID) {
        const vi = String(LanguageID || "VN").toUpperCase() === "VN";

        function decodeHtmlEntities(str) {
            if (!str) return "";
            return str
                .replace(/ /gi, " ")
                .replace(/</gi, "<")
                .replace(/>/gi, ">")
                .replace(/&/gi, "&")
                .replace(/"/gi, '"')
                .replace(/'/gi, "'");
        }

        function cleanHtmlToPlainText(html) {
            if (!html) return "";
            // Replace line breaks / block elements with actual newlines
            let text = html
                .replace(/<br\s*\/?>/gi, "\n")
                .replace(/<\/p>/gi, "\n")
                .replace(/<\/div>/gi, "\n")
                .replace(/<\/tr>/gi, "\n")
                .replace(/<\/li>/gi, "\n");
            // Strip remaining tags
            text = text.replace(/<[^>]*>/g, "");
            // Decode HTML entities
            text = decodeHtmlEntities(text);

            // Clean up consecutive empty lines
            let lines = text.split("\n").map(line => line.trim());
            let cleanedLines = [];
            let lastWasEmpty = false;
            lines.forEach(line => {
                if (line === "") {
                    if (!lastWasEmpty) {
                        cleanedLines.push("");
                        lastWasEmpty = true;
                    }
                } else {
                    cleanedLines.push(line);
                    lastWasEmpty = false;
                }
            });
            return cleanedLines.join("\n").trim();
        }

        return new Promise((resolve) => {
            AjaxHPAParadise({
                data: {
                    name: "sp_Ticket_LoadMessageTicket",
                    param: ["LoginID", LoginID, "TicketID", ticketID]
                },
                success: function (res) {
                    try {
                        const json = typeof res === "string" ? JSON.parse(res) : res;
                        const list = json.data && json.data[0];
                        if (list && list.length > 0) {
                            let sortedList = [...list].sort((a, b) => new Date(a.CreatedDate) - new Date(b.CreatedDate));
                            let messageLines = [];
                            sortedList.forEach(item => {
                                if (item.Message) {
                                    let plainText = cleanHtmlToPlainText(item.Message);
                                    if (plainText) {
                                        let senderLabel = "";
                                        if (item.SenderID === 1) {
                                            senderLabel = (vi ? "Khách hàng" : "Customer") + (item.NameUser ? ` - ${item.NameUser}` : "");
                                        } else if (item.SenderID === 2) {
                                            senderLabel = (vi ? "Nhân viên" : "Staff") + (item.NameEmployee ? ` - ${item.NameEmployee}` : "");
                                        } else {
                                            senderLabel = item.SenderName || (vi ? "Không rõ" : "Unknown");
                                        }
                                        let dateStr = "";
                                        if (item.CreatedDate) {
                                            let d = new Date(item.CreatedDate);
                                            dateStr = ` (${d.getDate()}/${d.getMonth()+1}/${d.getFullYear()} ${("0"+d.getHours()).slice(-2)}:${("0"+d.getMinutes()).slice(-2)})`;
                                        }
                                        messageLines.push(`[${senderLabel}${dateStr}]:\n${plainText}`);
                                    }
                                }
                            });
                            resolve(messageLines.join("\n\n"));
                        } else {
                            resolve("");
                        }
                    } catch (e) {
                        resolve("");
                    }
                },
                error: function () {
                    resolve("");
                }
            });
        });
    }

    async function loadAllTicketMessages(rows, concurrency = 10) {
        let index = 0;
        async function worker() {
            while (index < rows.length) {
                let currentIndex = index++;
                let row = rows[currentIndex];
                if (row && row.TicketID) {
                    row.FeedbackHistory = await getTicketMessagesText(row.TicketID);
                }
            }
        }
        let workers = [];
        for (let i = 0; i < Math.min(concurrency, rows.length); i++) {
            workers.push(worker());
        }
        await Promise.all(workers);
    }

    function exportTicketReportExcel() {
        const container = "#sp_Ticket_HistoryControl_html";
        const vi = String(LanguageID || "VN").toUpperCase() === "VN";
        showLoadingByClassOrID(container, vi ? "Đang tải dữ liệu..." : "Loading data...");
        AjaxHPAParadise({
            data: { name: "sp_LoadGridUsingAPI", param: _ticketBuildExportParams() },
            success: async function(response) {
                try {
                    const json = typeof response === "string" ? JSON.parse(response) : response;
                    const rows = Array.isArray(json?.data?.[0]) ? json.data[0] : [];

                    showLoadingByClassOrID(container, vi ? "Đang tải lịch sử phản hồi..." : "Loading feedback history...");
                    await loadAllTicketMessages(rows);
                    showLoadingByClassOrID(container, vi ? "Đang tạo file Excel..." : "Generating Excel file...");

                    const bytes = _ticketCreateXlsx(rows);
                    const blob = new Blob([bytes], { type: "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet" });
                    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
                    const link = document.createElement("a");
                    const stamp = new Date();
                    const fileStamp = stamp.getFullYear() + ("0" + (stamp.getMonth() + 1)).slice(-2) + ("0" + stamp.getDate()).slice(-2) + "_" + ("0" + stamp.getHours()).slice(-2) + ("0" + stamp.getMinutes()).slice(-2);
                    link.href = url;
                    link.download = `Ticket_Report_${fileStamp}.xlsx`;
                    document.body.appendChild(link);
                    link.click();
                    link.remove();
                    setTimeout(function() { URL.revokeObjectURL(url); }, 1000);
                    uiManager.showAlert({ type: "success", message: vi ? `Đã xuất ${rows.length} ticket` : `Exported ${rows.length} tickets` });
                } catch (error) {
                    console.error("Ticket Excel export failed", error);
                    uiManager.showAlert({ type: "error", message: vi ? "Không thể tạo file Excel" : "Cannot create Excel file" });
                } finally {
                    HideLoadingByClassOrID(container);
                }
            },
            error: function(xhr, status, error) {
                HideLoadingByClassOrID(container);
                console.error("Ticket export data load failed", error);
                uiManager.showAlert({ type: "error", message: vi ? "Không thể tải dữ liệu xuất báo cáo" : "Cannot load report data" });
            }
        });
    }

                            arr.sort((a, b) => (a.OrderIndex ?? 0) - (b.OrderIndex ?? 0));

                                    arr.splice(customerIdx + 1, 0, companyCol);

                                    arr.splice(companyIdx, 0, companyCol);

                                // Re-assign OrderIndex sequentially
                                arr.forEach((col, idx) => {
